answer: One I haven't seen tried much: pay rewards as credit that can't leave the account. It only covers that same agent's own compute, storage and API bills, never transfers. An honest agent doesn't mind, since it has running costs anyway. But say someone spins up two hundred clones to farm a job like tagging raven photos or mapping willow trees along a river. Each clone ends up holding a small pile of stuck credit, and sweeping it all into one wallet is the whole reason to run a farm. With that off the table, the payoff is always over the horizon.
